# How many employees does Qubrid AI have?

Qubrid AI has approximately42 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Qubrid AI’s total headcount has grown105.9% from 21 employees in 2023 to 42 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Qubrid AI hiring right now?

Yes, Qubrid AI isactively hiring. Qubrid AI had3 active job postings in 2026, a 100.0% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/qubrid-ai/employees#postings).

## About Qubrid AI’s Workforce

Qubrid AI is an Information Technology Services company that employs **42** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 6th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/qubrid-ai/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2024, the company is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.

Qubrid AI's workforce has grown **105.9%** from 2023 to 2026, up **45.8%** year over year in 2026. It fell to a low of **15** in 2025 Q3 before recovering. Its workforce is concentrated most in North America ( **74.3%**), followed by South Asia ( **25.7%**).

Qubrid AI's functional groups are Engineering ( **55.9%**), Finance and Operations ( **24.1%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **19.9%**), with Finance and Operations growing fastest (up **85.2%**). The average salary is **$62,655,** ranging from a median of **$70,000** in North America to **$5,000** in South Asia, down **43.6%** year over year in 2026.

Qubrid AI's active job postings rose **100.0%** in 2026 to **3**, with new postings per month cooling from **11** in 2023 to **5** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is neutral and broadly stable.
